question: Should the supported agent contract expose only aggregate spawn capacity, or also identify which agents and sessions are busy?
rationale: The implementation gap is proven, but the issue's broad workload example crosses visibility and orchestration boundaries that current code intentionally does not define.

options.title: Aggregate spawn capacity
options.body: Expose available subagent capacity and lane saturation scoped to agents and lanes the caller may dispatch to.

options.title: Filtered per-agent workload
options.body: Expose identifiable workload only after defining explicit cross-agent authorization, redaction, and stability rules.

options.title: Operator-only snapshot
options.body: Add human diagnostics consumers but keep scheduling state out of model-visible tools.

recommendation.title: Aggregate spawn capacity
recommendation.body: Expose available subagent capacity and lane saturation scoped to agents and lanes the caller may dispatch to.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both the queue runtime and agent-tool contract surfaces involved in this decision.
